# DMTABLES

Another name for CTABLES.

## Syntax

```text
DMTABLES [/subcommands of CTABLES].
```

The same command as CTABLES, with the same subcommands and defaults.

## Example

```text
DMTABLES /TABLE region BY bought [COUNT, ROWPCT.COUNT].
```

`statscraft help DMTABLES` prints the same text in the terminal. [All commands](README.md)
